scope: Persisted superadmin create, update, delete and safe user readback for Brand, Team and User resources in API and Cloud.

environment.database: Separate disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 databases for API and Cloud on localhost.
environment.tenants: Synthetic Tenant A and Tenant B only.
environment.network: Only local HTTP services and the isolated PostgreSQL cluster; no customer/provider endpoint.

assertions_per_backend: Authenticated as a database-authorized superadmin and listed both synthetic Companies.
Created, updated and deleted a Brand under Tenant A.
Created, updated and deleted a Team under the new Brand.
Created a User with role=user, assigned admin as superadmin, and read it back without password, hash, token or secret fields.
Deleted the synthetic superadmin fixture through the authenticated API after the CRUD checks.
Queried PostgreSQL to verify zero remaining UAT-5.1.73 test accounts; created Brand/Team rows were absent after API cleanup.
limitations: This verifies a representative persisted lifecycle for Brand, Team and User under superadmin in two local isolated backends; it does not close the full 39-model × role × surface × operation matrix.
Superadmin breadth outside these resource families and cross-tenant destructive boundaries remain to be measured separately.
